selection_summary.receipt_boundary: Candidate retrieval cuts, not common-unit membership, compatibility, ancestry or source-verified selection rationales.

units.rationale: Candidate whole transformation from each separately recovered, timed total-RNA preparation to a cleaned 4sU-enriched RNA fraction. Biotin-HPDP installs an affinity handle, organic extraction/precipitation removes free reagent, and streptavidin retention followed by DTT elution recovers the labeled cohort. Keeping both operations preserves the handle-to-selection mechanism and its intermediate RNA mixture. Fuchs primary batch27_4sudrb_seq_main p00030-p00031 supplies the production route; cited Rabani p00040 contextualizes chemistry but its 20 microgram input and unlabeled-flow-through recovery are not adopted. Enriched RNA feeds library preparation; this cut neither creates the upstream temporal label nor selects poly(A). Useful for comparing molecular cohort enrichment, subject to residual mature-RNA contamination.

Candidate connected decoding transformation from eligible intron profiles with separate 0/4/8-minute replicate identities to accepted elongation-rate, confidence and effective-delay estimates. Rough background-corrected wave detection supplies the anchor for derivative refinement, which supplies boundaries for replicate filtering and the time-position fit. Keeping these stages together retains missing-call and rough-boundary fallback behavior and the four-reference baseline, rather than treating a boundary as a rate. Relevant primary context is batch27_4sudrb_seq_main p00020 and p00034-p00040. Upstream gene eligibility remains an input contract; refined boundaries and rates also feed external initiation inference. Useful for comparing time-resolved inference designs, without asserting exact numerical reproduction or interpreting effective delay independently of uniform-velocity assumptions.

Candidate whole transformation from tagged genomic DNA to the cleaned amplified library under analytical qPCR control. Initial five-cycle amplification feeds a physical split; the monitoring aliquot generates an additional-cycle decision while the retained production material is amplified and cleaned separately. Connectivity includes both material paths and the explicit cycle_control edge. The standard Minelute-purified input and low-cell direct-transfer input remain alternatives. Primary acquired_atac_documented_manuscript_html_80310c92 p00136-p00141 supports this boundary, including preservation of the unselected size mixture. Useful for comparing amplification-bias control, while leaving aliquot volume and numerical fluorescence rule unknown; twenty analytical cycles are not twenty extra production cycles, and no later one-third-maximum rule is imported.

Candidate spatial-encoding transformation from the fixed, original-panel ADT-stained tissue section to tissue-retained RNA/ADT-derived cDNAs carrying Ai-Bj intersection addresses, UMI and biotinylated PCR handle. First-axis in situ RT creates the A-bearing substrate consumed by orthogonal, linker-templated B ligation; their material handoff makes the pair one encoding purpose. Primary liu2020_primary p00010, p00041-p00043 and p00060, together with Table S2 A/B and linker entries, support the architecture. Preserve the frozen joint RNA/ADT, 50-micrometre variant and optional channel images consumed by later tissue registration. Useful for comparing spatial address writing; pixels are not isolated single cells, and linker quantity plus joint blocking placement remain unresolved.

Candidate bounded length-selection transformation from cleaned pooled, individually barcoded ligation products plus assay design to the retained Pippin Prep fraction. Automated agarose-based size selection acts jointly with already established restriction endpoints to tune genomic representation and shared locus recovery. Primary ddradseq_peterson2012 p00009-p00010 and p00026 and Protocol S1 p00014-p00017 support the purpose and interface. The 76-bp adapter offset belongs in the design contract; empirical 300 +/-24 or +/-36-bp windows are alternatives whose exact coordinate convention is unresolved. External gel selection is an alternative route; optional P2 enrichment and PCR remain consumers. Length selection alone does not establish unlike restriction ends on every retained molecule.

Candidate whole transformation from one separately picked frozen cultured cell and its ERCC addition to two physically allocated halves of a jointly amplified gDNA/cDNA mixture. Barcoded poly(A)-primed RT retains gDNA, seven-round random-primed quasilinear amplification copies both substrates, and the actual split establishes the genome- and transcriptome-processing branches with shared cell origin. Primary batch27_dr_seq_main p00005, p00007 and p00019 supplies the route; CEL-Seq primer design and MALBAC looping remain explicitly attributed dependencies, with the DR-seq seven-round recipe taking precedence. Useful for comparing same-cell multi-analyte preservation and branching. Neither half is a purified nucleic-acid class; length identifiers, unresolved full Ad-2 pool and later coding-region ambiguity must remain visible.

Candidate whole identity-transfer transformation from a prepared single-cell inlet and selected prepared barcoded beads to washed, covalent bead-associated cDNA STAMPs. Sparse droplet co-encapsulation enables lysis and poly(A) capture; breaking droplets retains noncovalent RNA-bead association; bulk RT/template switching then makes transcript-barcode/UMI attribution covalent before unextended-primer cleanup. Primary macosko2015_primary p00009-p00010 and supplement p00005-p00007, p00026 support these materially connected stages. Tissue/culture and bead-design alternatives remain separate choices. Useful for comparing compartment-to-molecule identity transfer; doublets, ambient RNA and association loss remain possible. Droplet microscopy is an analytical branch without a reported feedback rule, and the independent ERCC route is not a sample spike-in here.

Candidate connected transformation from an individual cell lysate, or a separately processed matched negative tube, to a cleaned indexed post-bisulfite library. Bisulfite encodes cytosine status while fragmenting DNA before adapter addition; five first-adapter priming/extension rounds, cleanup, biotin/streptavidin strand capture, second-adapter synthesis and index PCR preserve the entire low-input library-construction purpose. Primary pmid_25042786 p00008-p00009 and p00018-p00020 distinguishes the single-cell route from modified bulk preparation. Useful for comparing conversion-before-tagging designs and recovery interfaces. Oocyte, ESC and negative tubes remain alternatives with separate identities, never merged. Post-conversion purification is delegated and incompletely specified; exact PE1.0/iPCRTag identities and negative-control pool arrangement remain unresolved.

Candidate whole transformation from separately labeled/control total-RNA preparations to indexed Quant-seq 3-prime libraries carrying RT-dependent s4U recoding information. Iodoacetamide carboxyamidomethylation and recovery feed the implemented oligo-dT first-strand, random-primed second-strand and PCR construction, keeping the chemical change connected to its readable DNA output. Primary acquired_primary_europepmc_jats_a306191f p00004-p00005, p00018, p00021 and p00029-p00030 plus recovered Supplementary Figure 6 p00004 support this route. Useful for comparing label-to-sequence encoding without affinity purification. Restrict interpretation to the original Quant-seq implementation; library internals, DTT quench amount and actual index choices remain delegated/unknown. Upstream pulse/chase design and downstream SNP exclusion/no-s4U background correction are necessary context, not accomplished by this cut.

Candidate whole transformation from a selected fixed cell/nucleus suspension and externally prepared barcode assemblies to physical sublibraries bearing three in situ well labels plus UMI/biotin/PCR-handle functionality. RT, successive split-ligate-block-pool rounds and actual sublibrary partitioning form a material route; blocking prevents free barcodes from relabeling cDNA after pooling. Primary acquired_splitseq_primary_pmc_08823e62 p00136/p00140 and supplement p00016-p00026, p00083-p00084 support this purpose. Useful for comparing combinatorial compartment-based encoding and loading design. The fourth sublibrary barcode is added by later library PCR and remains an explicit external completion requirement. Preserve whole-cell/nucleus/preserved alternatives, 48-well detailed RT versus 96-well overview, possible collisions, absent full oligo dictionary and ambiguous ligation wording.

preselection_comparison.summary: Neither of the two positive comparison opportunities is sampled at its declared spans; the ATAC/SPLiT tagmentation trap is unselected; both SLAM/scBS trap constituents are contained only within larger cuts. No trap or relation has been adjudicated.

selection_purpose_assessment.observed: The planner samples assay-defining encoding, selection and readout cores, with one or two cuts per parent. This gives broad parent representation but not a set optimized for cross-method commonality.
selection_purpose_assessment.under_sampled: Shared post-capture cDNA amplification and Nextera library-preparation spans on DBiT/SPLiT are both absent, as are several other common downstream library operations. Their absence can prevent the next stage from proposing those correspondences in this bounded manifest.
selection_purpose_assessment.limit: A ten-cut cap and an informative-open-discovery prompt did not require any particular positive pair. This is a sampling limitation, not a wrong edge, failed gold recall metric or proof that useful common transformations do not exist.

information_and_uncertainty.observed: Saved information_effects are exact parent-operation strings, not new whole-unit paraphrases. All parent unresolved gaps and resolutions are inherited, as are alternative/conditional typed flows, side outputs and external-operation references. All ten mechanism fields remain not_separately_assessed.
positive_examples: DBiT encoding retains optional image outputs and external registration context without claiming pixels are single cells.
SPLiT cut stops before the fourth barcode; its rationale names the external completion requirement and collision/oligo uncertainties.
Drop cut retains noncovalent capture-to-covalent RT transitions and leaves independent ERCC/ddPCR unselected.
SLAM rationale explicitly leaves upstream pulse/chase and downstream SNP/background correction external; scBS keeps specimen/control tubes as alternatives.
